summary: Two documentation-only fixes found while dogfooding the browser-automation fallbacks: (1) the one-time dedicated-Chrome setup that avoids repeated fallback logins was documented only on `hotels search --help`, not on any of the four commands whose own error message says "see --help" for it; (2) README.md and SKILL.md's `go install` instructions pointed at the wrong module path.
reason: (1) Confirmed live 2026-09-28 on the current binary (`expenses create --help`, `expenses update --help`, `reports submit --help`, `reports create --help`, and root `--help`) that none of them mention CDP, debug ports, or the one-time setup at all -- the runtime error each of their browser fallbacks prints ("...or set up a dedicated debug-enabled Chrome profile to skip this every time; see --help") points at their OWN --help, which had nothing. The actual recipe already existed, correctly, on `hotels search --help` (added by the prior unify-browser-auth-sessions.json patch) and in the published README's Authentication section -- it just wasn't repeated on the other four commands that hit the identical gap, so a user hitting the error on e.g. `expenses create` had no reason to think to check a different command's help text. (2) `go install github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library/library/accounting/concur/cmd/concur-pp-cli@latest` (and the matching concur-pp-mcp line) 404s -- this CLI's actual module path is `library/productivity/concur`, confirmed by a real `go install` of that path succeeding live 2026-09-28. A fresh user following either doc file's own install instructions verbatim fails at the very first step.

changes.description: Added a Long help text (this command had none before) documenting the browser fallback's optional persistent-session setup, consistent with hotels_search.go's existing Long text.

Same addition as expenses_create.go, plus a closing reminder not to trust this command's own success message alone (matches the verification step this session actually used: reports get --select approvalStatus,isSubmitted,submitDate).

Same addition as expenses_create.go (this command's fallback is for a missing policyId, not the shared 404/405 defect the other three hit, but shares the identical isolated-unauthenticated-browser gap and setup fix).
Fixed the go install module path on both the concur-pp-cli and concur-pp-mcp lines (library/accounting/concur -> library/productivity/concur).
Same module-path fix, at all three occurrences (the MCP server config example and both go install lines).

validated_outcome: go build, go vet ./..., gofmt (no new drift introduced by these edits -- two pre-existing, untouched files already had unrelated gofmt drift, confirmed via git status that this patch's diff does not touch either), and go test ./... all clean. `go install github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library/library/productivity/concur/cmd/concur-pp-cli@latest` re-run live to confirm the corrected path actually installs.
